final: SELECT MIN(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) as youngest_patient_age FROM Patient p WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL AND p.`First Date` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 0
